scope: Selected x64 V6 native RTM commit, nesting, rollback and refusal; native CPUID header repair
path_normalization: Private checkout, build and executable paths are represented by repository-relative names and artifact/tool placeholders. Original artifact digests are retained.
round_definition: Each round seeds all represented state, RAM and guest stack; invokes the selected transaction, standalone XTEST/XABORT, standalone XEND refusal, a two-instruction rollback attempt, and invalid/zero-budget inputs. Only the nine admitted original-code scenarios invoke the independent raw-code oracle. These counts are not instruction-coverage percentages.

llvm_header_checks.compiler: Host Clang; no new Clang executable build is claimed

cpuid_regression.cause: The XCHG temporary in the old public header lacked early-clobber. With dead EAX/ECX/EDX outputs it could share EAX, changing the CPUID leaf and clobbering live RBX.
cpuid_regression.fallback: Early-clobber fix is also retained in NeverC and the LLVM fork Clang header; native and compatibility header paths execute at O0/O2.

limitations: SDE 10.13.1 processor-model execution, not physical RTM hardware.
Forced-abort SDE mode clears CPUID RTM; production providers decline it.
CPUID/PAUSE qualify real non-explicit abort publication after body entry, not forced early abort at the initial XBEGIN.
Original RAM excludes state, context, code and private compiler storage; no MMIO, faults, debug traps or asynchronous delivery.
Other system effects, nonstatus flag changes, unowned intrinsic bodies, noncanonical prefixes and i386 continuation state remain outside the binding.
A selected set using all 256 original XABORT codes has no private rollback channel and fails export.
Capacity/conflict behavior, progress and native abort-reason equivalence are not promised.
Other x86 state contracts remain open; no LLVM SDK release or production pin update is claimed.
